title: Floorplan Improver
about: A traced canvas → a furnished, tiled, lit, render-ready canvas. In a pipeline the Object Resolver's resolve.json is LOCKED: PLACE puts those items as given; IMPROVE only adds what the brief did not list.

PLACE.title: Place every resolved object on the room canvas

IMPROVE.title: Claude adds floors, lighting, trims (optional, keeps locked items)

APPROVE.title: The user checks the room canvas
